question: In which year did Babur defeat Ibrahim Lodi?
solution: The correct answer is __**1526**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Babur**, the founder of the Mughal Empire, defeated **Ibrahim Lodi**, the last Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate, in the **Battle of Panipat** on **21st April 1526**. • This battle marked the end of the **Lodi Dynasty** and established Mughal rule in India. • The **Battle of Panipat** was a decisive conflict fought near the town of Panipat in modern-day Haryana. • Babur employed superior tactics, including the use of **field artillery**, which played a critical role in his victory over Ibrahim Lodi's much larger army. • The battle is considered a turning point in Indian history as it led to the establishment of the **Mughal Empire**, which ruled India for over 300 years.
